import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query to find distinct healthcare institutions within 3000m of any GENERAL station
# Using PostGIS ST_Centroid and ST_Distance functions
query = text("""
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sa.id) as count
FROM sensitive_area sa
WHERE sa.category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM air_quality_station aqs
    WHERE aqs.station_type = 'GENERAL'
    AND ST_Distance(
        ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography,
        aqs.coordinate::geography
    ) <= 3000
)
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)
